blogs.title: Can Web Scraping Beat Closed-Source Giants? How DeepSeekMath Cracked the Math Code
blogs.description: This post explores the surprising discovery that massive amounts of public web data, scraped from Common Crawl, can rival the mathematical prowess of closed-source models like GPT-4 and Gemini-Ultra. We'll break down how DeepSeekMath built a 120-billion-token 'DeepSeekMath Corpus' using a clever iterative filtering process, proving that data quality and quantity matter just as much as model size.

blogs.title: Say Goodbye to Heavy Critics: Meet GRPO, the Lightweight RL Algorithm Taking Over Math Reasoning
blogs.description: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is powerful but notoriously expensive due to the need for separate 'critic' models. In this article, we dive deep into Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a breakthrough technique introduced in the paper. Learn how GRPO replaces heavy critics with simple group scoring to save memory and boost performance, making high-end math reasoning accessible on smaller hardware.

blogs.title: The Surprising Link Between Coding and Calculus: Why Code Training Boosts Math Skills
blogs.description: Does learning to code actually make you better at math? The DeepSeekMath team found a resounding yes. This blog explains their unique training strategy: initializing their model with code pre-training before diving into mathematics. We discuss how this hybrid approach not only improved solving complex equations but also prevented 'catastrophic forgetting,' keeping coding skills sharp while unlocking new reasoning superpowers.
